notes:
Fixed the following bugs:
Most serious (data safety and security)

Read-only SAM connection: the guard that stops anything except SELECT queries could be tricked with quote marks or comments into running a second command, such as a DELETE. It’s rewritten and now refuses those, plus linked-server names.
Count rows in SAM: this failed on every query that had a sort order (113 of 194 export files). Fixed.
Team folder: one PC saving its settings could overwrite a teammate’s newer changes, and joining an existing team folder could replace the team’s settings with this PC’s blank ones. Both fixed.
Settings file: it’s now written safely with a backup copy. If it’s ever damaged, the app falls back to the last good copy instead of silently starting empty.
Data updates: publishing could leave every PC unable to download data updates, because files merged in from GitHub no longer matched the published file fingerprints. The publish order is fixed and the fingerprints are re-checked before pushing.
Safety net: if a file that was sent last night went missing, it didn’t stop the upload. It now holds the upload.
School limit: when a query’s filter groups were combined with “any group may match”, the school limit didn’t apply, so other schools’ rows could reach the vendor. Fixed.
Backup files: a tampered backup could write files outside the app’s folders. Fixed.

Things that silently stopped working

Renaming: renaming an upload profile or report email broke its nightly task. Renaming a district hid its saved queries. All three now carry over.
Changing districts or schedules:
Adding a second district left duplicate scheduled tasks running.
Backups and data-quality snapshots had no way to remove their scheduled task; there’s now a Remove schedule button for each.
Switching districts kept the admin PIN unlocked, and the setup wizard could get around the PIN.
Filters: opening Step 4 erased any “Ask” prompts on filters.
Unsaved edits: a dialog left open could save an old copy of the settings over District Settings changes. Edits in Upload setup, Report emails and the privacy register were lost when you switched rows or closed the window.
Import existing SQL: several patterns changed what the query returns, including NOT LIKE, LEFT JOINs written in a certain order, CASE and CAST, GROUP BY and TOP PERCENT. They now import correctly or are kept exactly as written.

Smaller fixes

SQL and imports:
Some generated SQL wouldn’t run on SQL Server: totals with a text-only column (two SAM setup check queries), blank column headings, and a column named Precision.
The codes import crashed on an unquoted comma.
App and Build GUI:
The Build GUI froze or crashed when a tool path was wrong.
A failed build no longer bumps the version number.
Startup crashes are now logged and shown on screen instead of closing silently.
The installer now removes old program files on upgrade.
Exports and attachments:
Excel attachments failed on odd characters in SAM notes.
Large shared community queries produced a broken link.
A dry run filled the archive folder, and the archive is now pruned.

One behavior change: View → Text size now applies after a restart, like the theme does. Changing it live could crash the app.

data.notes: Initial table catalog, starter templates, 52 platform export packages with checking rules, data cleanup reports, SAM setup check, shared package library and Query Assistant vocabulary.
